status: Current animal defender recipe; mechanical overhead tower recipe is historical
camera: Use style.json defenderCamera; same scale and light in all views.

parts.body: Head, torso, tail/shell and both planted legs; no arms or held object. Clear silhouette, full body, transparent margin.
parts.holdArm: Whole arm isolated. Shoulder pivot, elbow and grip crop-local landmarks.
parts.drawArm: Whole action arm isolated. Shoulder pivot, elbow and grip crop-local landmarks.
parts.bowOrPayload: Separate bow for archer; rock/net bundle/purse payload for thrower/trader.

descriptor.portrait.bodyCrop: Optional side-body crop in body-local pixels; use for UI portrait.

process: Generate native separated-parts sheet and retain exact prompt/source.
Measure actual crop rectangles and landmarks; never assume requested dimensions.
Inspect then import to a NEW id with cutout-pipeline; never overwrite an approved id.
Encode delivery with encode-rig; exact alpha check must pass.
Keep descriptor spec and runtime behavioral metadata in sync.
Review four facings and windup/release/recovery at real game size; verify fixed limbs, held-object contact, projectile origin and planted feet.
Review selection at adjacent tiles and phone landscape. Numeric validation never substitutes for visual review.
